messages:
fiona_csops: FYI I'm seeing a ping-pong in healthscore-triggered nudges. Customers dip below renewal_threshold, get a nudge, then usage drops and score dips more -> more nudges. We sent ~48 nudges in the last 8h, many to the same cohort.
leo_data: That's the classic feedback loop. The scorer uses last_7d_active and email_sent_count as features; playbook nudges increment email_sent_count immediately so the scorer reacts on next run. We accidentally included email_sent_count in the short-window features.
anya_onboard: Oof. Which playbook? I saw increased activity in `renewal_nudge_sequence_v2` and `health-recheck`. Some customers are mid-onboarding and got 2 nudges.
mailer-bot: outbound-log: [2876549999] template=renewal_nudge account=acct-L77 sent_by=fiona_csops run=rn_223 queued=1
ops-bot: command: /playbook pause renewal_nudge_sequence_v2 acknowledged by fiona_csops at 2876550020 reason="hotfix: feedback-loop"
leo_data: Immediate mitigation: remove email_sent_count from short-window features and add a 24h cooldown feature instead. Also add a transient dedupe in playbook trigger: `AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM outbound_tracker o WHERE o.account=a.id AND o.template='renewal_nudge' AND o.sent_at > now() - interval '24 hours')`.
anya_onboard: Also require `a.onboarding_state = 'complete'` for renewal triggers. We keep seeing mid-onboard recipients.
fiona_csops: Good. Can you prepare a canary config? We want to test on pb-canary-01 and observe delta for 1h before rollout.
leo_data: Pushing canary change to scorer: removed email_sent_count from short_features, added cooldown flag. Will run a 2k-account simulation: `python tools/simulate_feedback.py --sample 2000 --model-variant=canary`
mailer-bot: job queued: simulate_feedback id=sim_449 status=running est=6m
leo_data: Also patching playbook trigger in-place: add `AND a.onboarding_state='complete'` + dedupe anti-join. Will canary that too.
ops-bot: playbook patch deployed to pb-canary-01 by leo_data at 2876550085
anya_onboard: If any customers already got >1 nudge, we'll collapse follow-ups and mark the sequence as single-touch for 48h.
fiona_csops: I'll start a customer export for outreach: `SELECT a.id, a.owner_id FROM accounts a JOIN outbound_tracker o ON o.account=a.id WHERE o.template='renewal_nudge' AND o.sent_at > now()-interval '12 hours'`
leo_data: Simulation results look good: feedback loop reduced by 92% in canary sample. Rolling to staging next after smoke.
mailer-bot: suppressed 32 queued sends via suppression-list upload (reason=feedback-loop-hotfix)
ops-bot: playbook resume deferred until verification complete. Manual resume when leo_data confirms 2h stable metrics.
fiona_csops: Postmortem actions: 1) Add "no short-window features that include outbound metrics" to scorer deploy checklist, 2) Playbook CI to assert dedupe/cooldown logic, 3) Add synthetic feedback-loop test to canary sim harness. I'll open CSOPS-13077 and assign tasks. ETA mitigation: 90m. :white_check_mark:
